hook: Your MacBook notch, now an agent dashboard

beats.say: ASV Labs open-sourced Tuck Notch, a free native Mac app that grows out of the MacBook notch.
Scripts, CI jobs and AI agents can post status updates and interactive alerts to it, next to music, meetings, weather and clipboard history.
It is signed and notarized, with no accounts or tracking. Deeper Claude Code progress and AirPods battery monitoring are next.
